sloka: सो ऽपश्यदरजां दीनां रजसा समभिप्लुताम् ।ज्योत्स्नामिव ग्रहग्रस्तां प्रत्यूषे न विराजतीम् ।। ७.८१.२ ॥
transliteration: so 'paśyadarajāṁ dīnāṁ rajasā samabhiplutām ।jyotsnāmiva grahagrastāṁ pratyūṣe na virājatīm ।। 7.81.2 ॥

translations.english: He saw Arajā, distressed and covered with impurity, like moonlight eclipsed by a planet and not shining brightly at dawn.
